action: Run H1 as controlled V60 using the unchanged IntentFeatureExtractor; preserve all original Antigravity files.

verified_code_findings.finding: Uses exact raw comments for folds, whereas current baseline uses normalized near-duplicate groups. Uses a different word-only SVD representation, so its score is not a controlled comparison with V11.
verified_code_findings.resolution: Reuse the verified V53 cluster splits, SVD128 representation and matching baseline prediction caches. Append seven intent columns only.

verified_code_findings.finding: Passes the scoring fold as CatBoost eval_set without explicitly disabling best-model selection. This can select the iteration on the same held-out labels used for reporting.
verified_code_findings.resolution: Fixed 800 iterations, no eval_set and no early stopping; same parameters as the baseline latent branch.

verified_code_findings.finding: Cross-fitting weights on existing global OOF is not strictly nested model validation: probabilities used for calibration may come from models trained using the outer held-out labels. Also, reference_v3 alone does not reconstruct V11 with its latent component.
verified_code_findings.resolution: Do not use this script's reported nested score for promotion. A valid nested experiment requires regenerating inner OOF within each outer fitting partition, with all learned transforms fit inside inner folds.

verified_code_findings.finding: The runner does not implement an H2 training branch. The ngram serializer exhausts all length-3 windows before length-4/5 windows, so long inputs truncated at 256 tokens may contain no 4/5-grams. The NumPy forward test is not the same multi-kernel PyTorch architecture. Random TextCNN training has already been tried in V14/V15; focal loss and this tokenizer would be distinct changes needing a controlled test.
verified_code_findings.resolution: Defer H2 until a real training loop, token ordering and padding tests are implemented; do not label it already evaluated.

interpretation_corrections: Official class 2 is review on brand only. Logistics/deferral may be predictive features but do not redefine the target or automatically determine a test label.
Hidden test labels and public/private allocation are unknown. Human readings of the changed test reviews do not establish their true labels or explain the exact leaderboard drop.

A confidence interval crossing zero is uncertainty, not mathematical proof that improvement is impossible. In V57 the class-1 predictions were identical, so its paired class-1 F1 delta is exactly zero in each bootstrap sample containing that class.
Changing more than 30 test predictions is not a statistical significance criterion and is not a goal of this experiment.
Novel fake F1 above .45 alone is not an improvement over the current clustered baseline (~.488); compare on identical held-out rows.
Existing gates and rejected experiments are retained. V60 results will not be used to retroactively relax its own release gates.
